searchText: What software tools do people use for doing Ethereum research, specifically simulations? For instance, simulating a (post merge) eth network from genesis with various percentages of malicious node. Ideally it would be all in a single process and I wouldn't have to worry about the networking, etc. I've spent a week trying do get something like this working trying to use teku/besu codebases as libraries but I'm not sure that I'm making any progress if you don't need real nodes, you probably can just do the math. If you have something that needs real nodes... then you need to create thousands of them
